title: Reverse clopen adjunction after scalar identification
statement: Let j : U → T be a clopen immersion of schemes. Let R and S be commutative ring sheaves on their pro-etale sites, with an isomorphism c from S to the literal restriction of R. Let F be literal module restriction followed by scalar restriction along c. For every L with adjunction L ⊣ F, there exists an adjunction F ⊣ L. Restriction and module categories are those of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]; the open site composition is that of [lem-pur-proetale-open-unit-evaluation]. This includes empty U and makes no quasi-compactness hypothesis. The open-composition functor is supplied with its standard continuity instance.

source.place: Tag 04TS, disjoint two-open ringed-module gluing; scalar transport and uniqueness of adjoints.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sf-clopen-reverse-module-adjunction] in ordinary mode to obtain e and adjunctions e.ordinary ⊣ restrict and restrict ⊣ e.ordinary. Restriction of scalars along c is an equivalence E. The pushforward composition isomorphism identifies restrict followed by E.functor with F. Compose E.symm.toAdjunction with e.adjunction to obtain E.inverse followed by e.ordinary ⊣ F. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies that composite with L. Compose the reverse adjunction with E.toAdjunction, and transport its right adjoint by this unique-left-adjoint isomorphism to get F ⊣ L.

proof_origin.place: Tag 04TS; purely formal scalar equivalence and adjunction transport.

from.place: Clopen open-to-direct-image comparison in proper/open refinement calculus.

lean.statement:
theorem clopenScalarRestrictionReverseAdjunction {U T : Scheme.{t}} (j : U ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsClosedImmersion j]
    [(proEtaleOpenComposition j).IsContinuous (ProEt.topology U) (ProEt.topology T)]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology U) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (c : S ≅ ((proEtaleOpenComposition j).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      CommRingCat.{t + 1} (ProEt.topology U) (ProEt.topology T)).obj R)
    (L : proEtaleRingModules U S ⥤ proEtaleRingModules T R)
    (adj : L ⊣ SheafOfModules.pushforward (F := proEtaleOpenComposition j)
      ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology U)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).map c.hom)) :
    Nonempty (SheafOfModules.pushforward (F := proEtaleOpenComposition j)
      ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology U)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).map c.hom) ⊣ L)
